title: Competencies
name: Name
pageDescription: Manage and track competency definitions and assessments
noBehavioralIndicatorsDescription: This competency doesn't have any behavioral indicators yet. Add some to start defining what success looks like.
noAssessmentQuestionsDescription: This competency doesn't have any assessment questions yet. Questions help evaluate behavioral indicators.
noStandardsMapped: No standards have been mapped to this competency yet.
deleteConfirmDescription: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete the competency and all associated data.
deleteConfirmDescriptionIndicators: Are you sure you want to delete this competency? This action will also remove all associated behavioral indicators and assessment questions.
basicInformationDescription: Name and description for this competency
standardMappingDescription: Link to O*NET, ESCO, or personality frameworks
standardsReferenceHelp: Map this competency to established frameworks like O*NET occupational skills, ESCO European skills taxonomy, or Big Five personality traits for standardized assessment alignment.

bigFiveSlot.title: Personality profile
bigFiveSlot.noMapping: No mapping derived from this O*NET selection. Pick a trait manually.
bigFiveSlot.emptyPrompt: Pick a personality trait or choose an O*NET anchor to auto-derive one

modal.onetDescription: Pick one occupational element. This anchors the competency and may auto-derive a Big Five trait.
modal.escoDescription: Pick an ESCO European skill or competence to add a parallel classification.

deleteFailed: Failed to delete competency. Please try again.
notFoundDeleted: Competency not found. It may have already been deleted.
createdNoId: Competency was created but no valid ID was returned. Please refresh and try again.
noDescriptionAvailable: No description available for this competency.
manageIndicatorsDescription: Manage behavioral indicators for this competency
weightDistributionDescription: Distribution of weights across behavioral indicators
filterIndicatorsDescription: Filter indicators assigned to this competency
currentIndicatorsDescription: Behavioral indicators assigned to this competency
noIndicatorsMatchFilter: No indicators match your current filters. Try adjusting your search criteria.
noIndicatorsYetDescription: This competency doesn't have any indicators yet. Create a new indicator or attach existing ones from other competencies.
connectionIssueDescription: Unable to connect to the server. This may be a temporary issue with the API.
networkErrorDescription: Unable to reach the server. Please check your internet connection.
errorLoadingDescription: An error occurred while loading the competency details.

statsCards.totalTooltip: The total number of competencies defined in the system across all categories and proficiency levels.
statsCards.withIndicatorsTooltip: Competencies that have at least one behavioral indicator linked. Indicators define observable behaviors used to measure each competency.
statsCards.avgWeightTooltip: The average weight assigned to behavioral indicators across all competencies. Weights determine how much each indicator contributes to the overall competency score.
statsCards.advancedTooltip: Competencies classified as Advanced or Expert proficiency level. These represent higher-order skills expected of senior professionals.
